 Technology Solutions
   

  

**Pay Details**
 $59,500 \- $84,000 CAD
   

  

 TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job\-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 The Junior AI Engineer supports the development, deployment, and ongoing support of AI/ML applications and AI\-powered agents. This role contributes to building intelligent systems using modern frameworks, assists in operationalizing AI capabilities, and ensures reliability and performance of AI solutions in production.
   

  

 The individual will work under guidance from senior engineers while gaining hands\-on experience in agent\-based architectures, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and enterprise AI platforms.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**AI/ML Application Development \& Support**
* Assist in building, deploying, and maintaining AI/ML applications and services
* Provide L2/L3\-style support for AI systems, including incident triage, debugging, and performance tuning
* Monitor model and application performance (accuracy, latency, cost) and support optimization efforts
* Maintain documentation and runbooks for AI solutions to support operational readiness


**AI Agent Development**
* Develop and enhance AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph
* Contribute to the design of agent workflows, tool integrations, and orchestration logic
* Support prompt engineering, context management, and structured output design
* Assist in integrating agents with APIs, enterprise systems, and data sources


**RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) Solutions**
* Support the development of RAG pipelines, including data ingestion, embedding, indexing, and retrieval
* Work with vector databases and search mechanisms to improve response relevance
* Assist in evaluating and improving grounding, hallucination control, and response quality


**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**
* Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver AI use cases
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to iterative delivery
* Stay current with emerging AI tools, frameworks, and best practices


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
* Working knowledge of Python for AI/ML development
* Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts and NLP
* Familiarity with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar
* Basic understanding of RAG architectures and LLM\-based applications
* Knowledge of REST APIs and software engineering fundamentals
* Experience with data manipulation (e.g., SQL, Pandas)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to LLM application development and agent\-based systems
* Exposure to predictive AI models a big plus
* Experience with vector databases
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Understanding of MLOps / LLMOps practices (deployment, monitoring, evaluation)
* Exposure to prompt engineering, embeddings, context engineering and model evaluation techniques
* Awareness of Responsible AI, governance, and data privacy considerations


**Key Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to quickly learn emerging AI tools and frameworks
* Attention to detail in debugging and supporting production systems
* Effective communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Curiosity and passion for AI, automation, and intelligent systems


**Who We Are**
 TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.
   

  

**Our Total Rewards Package**
 Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well\-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well\-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more
   

  

**Additional Information**
 We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.
   

  

 Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.
   

  

**Colleague Development**
 If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.
   

  

 If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.
   

  

 We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.
   

  

**Training \& Onboarding**

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Optimize Financial Group:** 




 Optimize Financial Group is a premier wealth management firm based in Toronto, ON, dedicated to helping clients achieve their long\-term financial goals. We provide personalized financial solutions spanning portfolio management, tax planning, debt management, retirement planning, and estate strategies. Our holistic approach aligns financial objectives with life ambitions, ensuring every client receives a thoughtful and tailored path to success.
 



  





**The opportunity:** 




 We are seeking a forward\-thinking AI Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize AI\-driven solutions that enhance efficiency, drive innovation, and support business growth across our advisory, operations, and client service functions. You will be responsible for building and refining intelligent systems, integrating AI tools and APIs, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to transform cutting\-edge technologies into practical, scalable business applications. This is a full\-time, on\-site position (Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.) at our downtown Toronto office.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 



* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain LLM\-based applications, prompt architectures, AI workflows, and automation tools that support client engagement, advisor support, operations, data analysis, and internal business processes.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to identify, scope, prioritize, and deliver high\-impact AI use cases, balancing business value, technical feasibility, implementation complexity, risk, and cost.
* Integrate AI\-powered applications, APIs, automation workflows, and internal data sources into existing business systems, ensuring solutions are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business needs.
* Develop and maintain a centralized AI knowledge and implementation library, including tested prompts, reusable workflows, model configurations, evaluation examples, integration patterns, documentation, and best practices.
* Create structured evaluation processes for AI solutions, including test cases, expected outputs, quality criteria, failure analysis, human\-in\-the\-loop review, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Support responsible AI implementation by helping define and apply best practices for privacy, data handling, output validation, documentation, auditability, and appropriate human oversight.
* Monitor emerging AI models, tools, vendors, frameworks, and implementation patterns to assess practical business applications and recommend where new capabilities can create measurable value.
* Support internal AI enablement by educating teams on effective AI usage, prompt design, workflow automation, responsible implementation, and the practical limitations of AI systems.



  





**Qualifications** 
 :
 


* Minimum of 2 years of relevant technical experience in software engineering, AI engineering, automation, data products, or technical business solutions, with hands\-on experience building or integrating generative AI tools, APIs, or platforms.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including experience designing, testing, deploying, debugging, documenting, and maintaining technical solutions in a production or business environment.
* Proficiency with Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar programming languages used to build, test, and integrate AI\-enabled applications and automation workflows.
* Experience working with LLM APIs, AI platforms, or generative AI development tools such as the OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar technologies.
* Experience using Git and platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket for version control, collaboration, code review, and deployment workflows.
* Strong understanding of LLM behavior, prompt optimization, context management, model limitations, hallucination risks, output validation, and applied AI design patterns.
* Experience integrating APIs, automation tools, databases, internal documents, and cloud\-based services such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud into business workflows or internal applications.
* Experience evaluating AI outputs using structured test cases, quality criteria, benchmark examples, human review workflows, failure analysis, or performance monitoring.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including privacy, data security, human oversight, documentation, auditability, and appropriate handling of client or business data.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI and technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to build or implement AI\-enabled solutions that improve real\-world business outcomes, such as efficiency, accuracy, client experience, scalability, process consistency, or decision support.



  





***Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment***




*As part of our recruitment and selection process, we may use technology\-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to assist with certain aspects of candidate screening, assessment, scheduling, and application review. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified individuals and are based on job\-related criteria, qualifications, and business requirements.*

 As an AI Engineer: Voice Designer, you’ll own the back\-end implementation and linguistic optimization of the Text\-to\-Speech (TTS) layer for our next\-generation AI voice agents. Lyra Technology Group is a private equity\-backed holding company that invests in and operates industry leading technology service businesses. Our companies are operated independently by exceptional management teams. Companies that join our group retain the employees, name, and culture that have made them successful. As a platform of Evergreen Services Group, we never divest from businesses we partner with and approach every decision with the goal of driving sustainable and healthy growth over the long term.
   

  

 We are looking for an AI Process Consultant (APC) for one of our operating companies. The APC will embed directly inside client businesses, uncovering the operational friction that holds them back, designing the workflows that will replace it, and partnering with AI Engineers to ship solutions that change how these organizations actually run. You won't be writing slide decks that get filed away; you'll be on\-site at small and mid\-size businesses interviewing operators, mapping processes, building the business case, and owning client outcomes from first conversation through post\-deployment adoption. You care about the outcome, not the deck.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, client\-facing strategy role built for someone who is as comfortable diagramming a workflow with C\-Suite leaders as they are co\-piloting a build session with engineers.
   

  

**Your work as an APC will include several components:**
* Embed directly with clients to run discovery, interviewing operators across roles, observing live workflows, and mapping current\-state processes that surface high\-ROI opportunities for AI and automation
* Build the business case for each engagement: quantify the cost of the status quo, model expected ROI, and prioritize a sequenced roadmap of automation opportunities the client can act on
* Design future\-state workflows in detail: process diagrams, decision logic, exception handling, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and integration touchpoints, all to a level of specificity engineering can build against
* Partner with an AI Engineer throughout the build, translating client requirements into technical specs, validating outputs against business intent, and brokering trade\-offs (quality vs. speed vs. cost vs. risk) in plain language
* Lead change management on the client side: stakeholder alignment, communication plans, training rollout, and adoption tracking
* Own the client relationship end\-to\-end: scope, expectations, status updates, escalations, and executive readouts. Serve as the single point of accountability for client outcomes
* Run post\-deployment business reviews to measure realized impact, surface follow\-on opportunities, and build the case for portfolio expansion
* Contribute internally by codifying reusable discovery frameworks, ROI models, workflow templates, and industry playbooks that scale across the practice


**Our ideal APC has the following qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field

* Working knowledge of modern AI capabilities and what LLMs, agents, and RAG systems can and can't do and the judgment to scope realistic AI solutions vs. avoid AI theater
* Ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast\-moving client environments. You attack messy problems without waiting for a project plan
* Exceptional communication skills. You can run a discovery interview with a warehouse foreman and an executive readout with a CEO on the same day
* Problem\-solver who gets energy from sitting across the desk from a real operator and figuring out where the friction actually is


**Preferred**

title: Data Acquisition & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Master Art Index**

Master Art Index (MAI) is building the definitive intelligence layer for the global art market. We develop AI\-driven valuation models, structured databases, and financial\-grade data infrastructure for blue\-chip modern and contemporary artworks. Our platform sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and art — enabling institutional\-quality analysis in one of the world's most opaque asset classes.

We are a cross\-functional team of AI engineers, computer vision specialists, product managers, and full\-stack developers. We move fast, value ownership, and build things that don't yet exist.

**Role Overview**

As Data Acquisition \& Infrastructure Engineer, you will be the foundation of MAI's data capabilities. Your primary focus will be the development and operation of automated data collection pipelines that aggregate publicly available information from across the art market ecosystem. You will also own the design and maintenance of the underlying database infrastructure — built on PostgreSQL and AWS — that stores and serves this data.

This is a high\-ownership role. The infrastructure is partially built; you will take it to production scale. You will work closely with AI engineers, a computer vision engineer, a product manager, full\-stack developers, and the Head of Art Research, reporting directly to the Head of AI Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**DATA PIPELINE \& COLLECTION**

– Architect and maintain automated pipelines that collect, normalize, and ingest publicly available art market data from web\-based sources

– Build reliable, maintainable collection systems using Python (Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Playwright, or equivalent), with a strong emphasis on resilience, scheduling, and data freshness

– Manage pipeline orchestration and scheduling using tools such as Apache Airflow, AWS EventBridge, or cron

– Navigate the practical challenges of large\-scale public data collection, including access patterns, rate constraints, and source reliability

– Handle messy, inconsistent real\-world datasets — clean, transform, and standardize data for downstream consumption

**DATABASE ENGINEERING**

– Design, build, and maintain relational database schemas in PostgreSQL (hosted on Amazon RDS) to support complex, multi\-entity art market data — artists, works, transactions, provenance, and valuation history

– Develop and optimize queries, indexes, and data models to ensure performance at scale

– Establish and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, and integrity constraints across the database

– Collaborate with AI engineers and the computer vision team to ensure the data layer supports model training and inference requirements

**INFRASTRUCTURE \& OPERATIONS**

– Deploy and manage pipeline workloads on AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS)

– Monitor pipeline health, data freshness, and system reliability — proactively address failures

– Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code practices as the team scales

**Core Requirements**

– 3–5 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related discipline

– Proven experience building and maintaining automated data collection pipelines from web\-based public sources using Python (Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Playwright, or Selenium)

– Strong data cleaning and normalization skills, with demonstrated ability to handle heterogeneous, inconsistent real\-world datasets

– Solid PostgreSQL experience: schema design, query optimization, and database maintenance

– Hands\-on AWS experience: Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS

– Experience scheduling and orchestrating data pipelines (Apache Airflow, AWS EventBridge, or equivalent)

– Experience navigating the constraints of large\-scale public data collection, including reliability, access patterns, and data freshness challenges

**Nice to Have**

– Knowledge of data quality frameworks and validation pipeline design

– Experience with containerization (Docker) and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, AWS CDK)

– Familiarity with ETL/ELT tooling (dbt, AWS Glue, or equivalent)

– Exposure to art market platforms (Christie's, Sotheby's, Artsy, Artnet) or understanding of how auction and gallery data is structured

– Background or genuine interest in the art world, collectibles, or alternative asset markets

– Experience in a startup or early\-stage environment where ownership and adaptability are essential

**What We Offer**

– A technically differentiated problem set — art market data is sparse, inconsistent, and largely unstructured; making it machine\-readable is genuinely hard

– High ownership from day one on infrastructure that is already in use and growing

– A lean, senior cross\-functional team: no bureaucracy, fast decisions, direct access to leadership

– Proximity to cutting\-edge AI and computer vision work applied to a non\-commoditized domain

– Flexible Friday remote work with four collaborative in\-office days in Montreal

– Competitive base compensation: $80,000 – $90,000 CAD, commensurate with experience

**Team \& Reporting**

This role reports to the Head of AI Engineering and works in close collaboration with:

– AI Engineers

– Computer Vision Engineer

– Product Manager

– Full\-Stack Developers

– Head of Art Research

**Master Art Index**

**Description de poste**

**Ingénieur(e) Acquisition de Données \& Infrastructure**

**Montréal (QC) · Présentiel (4 jours) / Télétravail (1 jour) · Temps plein · Niveau intermédiaire · 80 000 $ – 90 000 $ CA**

**À propos de Master Art Index**

Master Art Index (MAI) construit la couche d’intelligence de référence pour le marché mondial de l’art. Nous développons des modèles d’évaluation fondés sur l’intelligence artificielle, des bases de données structurées et des infrastructures de données de qualité institutionnelle pour les œuvres majeures d’art moderne et contemporain.

**Aperçu du poste**

En tant qu’**Ingénieur(e) Acquisition de Données \& Infrastructure**, vous constituerez le pilier des capacités de données de MAI.

Votre mission principale sera de développer et d’exploiter des pipelines automatisés de collecte de données agrégeant des informations publiques provenant de l’ensemble de l’écosystème du marché de l’art. Vous serez également responsable de la conception et de la maintenance de l’infrastructure de bases de données sous\-jacente — basée sur PostgreSQL et AWS — qui stocke et distribue ces données.

Il s’agit d’un poste à forte responsabilité. L’infrastructure est déjà partiellement construite ; votre rôle sera de la faire évoluer vers une exploitation à grande échelle en production.

Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les ingénieurs IA, un ingénieur en vision par ordinateur, un chef de produit, des développeurs full\-stack et la Responsable de la Recherche en Art, sous la supervision directe du Responsable de l’Ingénierie IA.

**Responsabilités principales**

**Collecte de données et pipelines**

* Concevoir et maintenir des pipelines automatisés permettant de collecter, normaliser et intégrer des données publiques provenant de sources web liées au marché de l’art.
* Développer des systèmes de collecte robustes et maintenables en Python (Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Playwright ou équivalent), avec une attention particulière portée à la résilience, à l’orchestration et à la fraîcheur des données.
* Gérer l’orchestration et la planification des pipelines à l’aide d’outils tels qu’Apache Airflow, AWS EventBridge ou des tâches cron.
* Relever les défis liés à la collecte de données publiques à grande échelle, notamment les modèles d’accès, les limitations de fréquence et la fiabilité des sources.
* Traiter des ensembles de données hétérogènes et imparfaits : nettoyer, transformer et standardiser les données pour les rendre exploitables en aval.

**Ingénierie de bases de données**

* Concevoir, développer et maintenir des schémas de bases de données relationnelles sous PostgreSQL (hébergées sur Amazon RDS) afin de gérer des données complexes et multi\-entités : artistes, œuvres, transactions, provenances et historiques de valorisation.
* Développer et optimiser les requêtes, index et modèles de données afin de garantir des performances à grande échelle.
* Définir et appliquer des standards de qualité des données, des règles de validation et des contraintes d’intégrité.
* Collaborer avec les ingénieurs IA et l’équipe de vision par ordinateur afin de garantir que la couche de données réponde aux besoins d’entraînement et d’inférence des modèles.

**Infrastructure et opérations**

* Déployer et administrer les charges de travail liées aux pipelines sur AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS).
* Surveiller la santé des pipelines, la fraîcheur des données et la fiabilité globale des systèmes ; identifier et résoudre de manière proactive les défaillances.
* Contribuer à la mise en place de pratiques d’Infrastructure as Code à mesure que l’équipe se développe.

**Profil recherché**

**Exigences essentielles**

* 3 à 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle en ingénierie des données ou dans une discipline connexe.
* Expérience démontrée dans la conception et la maintenance de pipelines automatisés de collecte de données à partir de sources web publiques utilisant Python (Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Playwright ou Selenium).
* Solides compétences en nettoyage, transformation et normalisation des données, avec une expérience concrète sur des jeux de données hétérogènes et imparfaits.
* Maîtrise de PostgreSQL : conception de schémas, optimisation de requêtes et administration de bases de données.
* Expérience pratique d’AWS : Lambda, EC2, S3 et RDS.
* Expérience dans la planification et l’orchestration de pipelines de données (Apache Airflow, AWS EventBridge ou équivalent).
* Expérience des contraintes liées à la collecte de données publiques à grande échelle, notamment en matière de fiabilité, de modèles d’accès et de fraîcheur des données.

**Atouts appréciés**

* Connaissance des cadres de gestion de la qualité des données et de la conception de pipelines de validation.
* Expérience avec la conteneurisation (Docker) et l’Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
* Familiarité avec les outils ETL/ELT (dbt, AWS Glue ou équivalent).
* Connaissance des plateformes du marché de l’art (Christie’s, Sotheby’s, Artsy, Artnet) ou compréhension de la structuration des données de galeries et de ventes aux enchères.
* Formation ou intérêt marqué pour le monde de l’art, les objets de collection ou les actifs alternatifs.
* Expérience dans un environnement startup ou en phase de croissance, où autonomie et adaptabilité sont essentielles.

**Ce que nous offrons**

* Des problématiques techniques différenciantes : les données du marché de l’art sont rares, incohérentes et largement non structurées ; les rendre exploitables par machine constitue un véritable défi.
* Une forte autonomie dès le premier jour sur une infrastructure déjà utilisée et en pleine croissance.
* Une équipe réduite et expérimentée, sans bureaucratie, avec des décisions rapides et un accès direct à la direction.

* Télétravail flexible le vendredi et quatre jours collaboratifs au bureau à Montréal.
* Une rémunération compétitive comprise entre **80 000 $ et 90 000 $ CA**, selon l’expérience.

* Model and persist lineage as a queryable knowledge graph supporting impact analysis, root\-cause tracing, and regulatory evidence generation.
* Build confidence scoring and validation so every lineage edge carries a provenance signal and a measure of certainty, with low\-confidence inferences surfaced for human review.
* Partner with the Firmwide Data Office, Risk, Compliance, and the divisional technology teams to align the platform with the Firm's data governance obligations, including BCBS 239, CCAR, GDPR, and SOX.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of AI and data engineers, setting engineering standards, reviewing designs, and owning delivery.
* Operate within Morgan Stanley's controls for AI safety, data confidentiality, and model governance.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* 8\+ years of software and data engineering experience, including a track record of leading complex platform builds end to end.
* Strong background in program analysis or compiler techniques: parsing, ASTs, intermediate representations, and static analysis. Hands\-on experience with tools such as ANTLR, tree\-sitter, sqlglot, or language\-native AST libraries.

* Experience modeling and querying graph data, with a graph database such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or Janus Graph.

* Working knowledge of BCBS 239 data aggregation and risk reporting principles and how they translate into engineering requirements.
* Experience harvesting metadata from enterprise ETL tools (Informatica, Talend) and BI platforms (Tableau, Power BI).
* Background in knowledge representation, semantic reasoning, or evaluation of LLM output quality and hallucination control.



  





**Tech Stack:** 




 Python, SQL, Spark, and Scala or Java for parsing targets. LLM and agent frameworks for reasoning. Graph databases for lineage storage. Workflow orchestration for pipeline execution. Cloud and on\-premise deployment with containerized services. OpenLineage\-aligned metadata models.

title: Ingénieur de données senior en IA - Famille de modèles SAP-RPT
description:
**Nous aidons le monde à mieux fonctionner**
 Chez SAP, nous faisons simple : vous apportez le meilleur de vous\-même, et nous ferons ressortir ce que vous avez de meilleur. Nous sommes des bâtisseurs qui touchent plus de 20 secteurs et 80 % du commerce mondial, et nous avons besoin de vos talents uniques pour façonner l’avenir. Le travail est exigeant – mais il a du sens.
   

  

 Vous trouverez ici un endroit où vous pouvez être vous\-même, où votre bien\-être est une priorité, et où vous aurez réellement votre place.
   

  

 Qu’est\-ce que cela vous apporte ? Un apprentissage constant, le développement de vos compétences, d’excellents avantages, et une équipe qui veut vous voir évoluer et réussir.
   

  

**Synthèse**
**Ce que vous ferez :**
 En tant que Senior Data \& AI Engineer pour la famille de modèles SAP\-RPT, vous construirez et développerez les bases techniques qui alimentent nos innovations en matière d’IA. Vous développerez des pipelines de données de haute qualité de bout en bout, exécuterez des extractions de données complexes et élaborerez les ensembles de données à haute valeur ajoutée essentiels pour nos équipes de recherche et d'ingénierie des modèles de base.
   

  

 En comblant l'écart technique entre les données brutes de l'entreprise et la recherche avancée sur l'IA, vous vous concentrerez sur les outils et les pipelines pour la conservation et l'affinage des actifs de données afin de garantir un maximum d'utilité et de performance. Tout en travaillant concrètement avec des outils de traitement de pointe, vous veillerez à ce que chaque ensemble de données respecte l'engagement indéfectible de SAP en faveur d'une conformité et d'une intégrité des données de pointe. C'est le rôle idéal pour une personne hautement technique et orientée détails désireuse de travailler au cœur de l'ingénierie des données et de contribuer au développement de l'un des rares modèles de base relationnelle au monde.
   

  

**Le rôle :**
* Contribue au développement de la famille de modèles de base tabulaires SAP\-RPT, en aidant à façonner les fonctionnalités prédictives de nouvelle génération pour les applications d'entreprise.
* Conçoit, crée et exploite des outils et pipelines de données évolutifs pour ingérer, traiter et organiser des données tabulaires à l'échelle de l'entreprise.
* Collabore avec les parties prenantes pour identifier, trouver et définir des cas d'utilisation tabulaires prédictifs à fort impact pour tous les produits et scénarios SAP.
* Extraire, nettoyer, valider et enrichir les données en mettant l'accent sur la qualité, la cohérence et la gouvernance ; préparer des jeux de données pour l'entraînement des modèles et le benchmarking.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les experts du domaine et les équipes de développement d'applications (par exemple, SAP S/4HANA) pour interpréter les données, les métadonnées et les artefacts de développement et les traduire en signaux prêts pour le ML.
* Travaillez main dans la main avec des experts des données et des chercheurs, partagez des analyses de données, des contraintes et des nuances pour vous assurer que les modèles sont efficacement adaptés aux données d'entreprise SAP.
* Effectuez une exploration approfondie des données pour identifier les modèles, les cas de périphérie, les risques de biais/fuite et les écarts de qualité qui guident directement le développement et l'évaluation des modèles.
* Influencer les décisions en matière d'architecture des données pour permettre un accès fiable, sécurisé et efficace aux données, à la fois pour les pipelines de formation et les déploiements de production.


**Ce Que Vous Apportez**
* Formation et expérience : doctorat ou Master en informatique, IA ou dans un domaine connexe, plus 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans des environnements de données à grande échelle et hautement performants.
* Expertise en données et domaine SAP : maîtrise éprouvée de SAP S/4HANA, ABAP et SAP GUI, avec une connaissance approfondie des données de gestion relationnelles et des schémas complexes. Doit démontrer une forte capacité à naviguer dans les modèles sémantiques (MDV, CDS, OData) et à appliquer une logique applicative de niveau entreprise aux objets de gestion clés et aux structures de table sous\-jacentes.
* Ingénierie des données et écosystème SAP : expérience avérée dans les bases de données SQL haute performance et la pile de données SAP (par exemple, BDC, HANA, BTP), notamment la création et l'exploitation de pipelines de données natifs du Cloud. Solides compétences en pythonisme; l'exposition aux graphes de connaissances est un atout (par exemple, des technologies comme le RDL).
* Apprentissage automatique : base solide dans l'apprentissage automatique avec une expérience pratique de développement Python en appliquant l'IA aux problèmes réels, idéalement dans les paramètres de données tabulaires/structurées.


**Qualifications Préférées**
* Dirige et soutient les initiatives stratégiques de plateforme de données axées sur l'habilitation des données évolutives et la création de valeur au sein de l'écosystème SAP.
* Possède une expérience dans les technologies Knowledge Graph (par exemple, RDF, SPARQL), les systèmes de gestion des métadonnées et/ou les modèles de données centrés sur le ML.


 Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la création et l'exploitation de pipelines de données/ML basés sur Python, à l'aide de technologies telles que Databricks, Azure ML, Airflow, PySpark, Ray et Azure Data Lake.
   

  

* Contribue aux projets de science des données/d'apprentissage automatique axés sur des données tabulaires (structurées), de la préparation des données au développement et au déploiement de modèles.


**Rencontrez Votre Équipe**
 SAP est idéalement placée pour diriger la prochaine vague d'IA en intégrant directement l'intelligence aux processus de gestion qui gèrent le monde. Notre équipe a pour mission de développer des modèles de base pour les données structurées, en commençant par le lancement et l’évolution continue de SAP\-RPT\-1\. En tant que première génération de notre portefeuille de modèles relationnels, SAP\-RPT\-1 représente notre engagement à lancer de nouvelles recherches dans un domaine où l'expertise de SAP dans les structures de données d'entreprise offre un avantage concurrentiel inégalé. Nous recherchons des innovateurs qui se joindront à nous pour développer des modèles nouvelle génération avec un impact encore plus élevé, en comblant le fossé entre les recherches de pointe sur l'IA et la réalité structurée et complexe des données d'entreprise mondiales.
   

  

**Faites ressortir le meilleur de vous\-même**
 Les innovations de SAP permettent à plus de quatre cent mille clients dans le monde de travailler ensemble plus efficacement et d'utiliser plus efficacement les informations commerciales. Connu à l'origine pour son leadership en matière de logiciels de planification des ressources d'entreprise (ERP), SAP a évolué pour devenir un leader du marché des logiciels d'application de gestion de bout en bout et des services connexes pour les bases de données, l'analytique, les technologies intelligentes et la gestion de l'expérience. En tant que société en nuage comptant deux\-cents millions d'utilisateurs et plus de cent mille employés dans le monde, nous sommes motivés et tournés vers l'avenir, avec une éthique d'équipe hautement collaborative et un engagement envers le développement personnel. Qu'il s'agisse de connecter des industries, des personnes ou des plates\-formes mondiales, nous veillons à ce que chaque défi reçoive la solution qu'il mérite. Chez SAP, vous pouvez faire ressortir le meilleur de vous\-même.
   

  

**Nous gagnons grâce à l'inclusion**
 La culture de l’inclusion chez SAP, l’accent mis sur la santé et le bien\-être, ainsi que les modèles de travail flexibles contribuent à garantir que chacun – quel que soit son parcours – se sente inclus et puisse donner le meilleur de lui\-même. Chez SAP, nous croyons que notre force réside dans les capacités et les qualités uniques que chaque personne apporte à notre entreprise, et nous investissons dans nos collaborateurs pour inspirer la confiance et permettre à chacun de réaliser son plein potentiel. Nous croyons fondamentalement en la libération de tous les talents et en la création d’un monde meilleur.
   

  

 SAP s'engage à respecter les principes d'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi et à adapter raisonnablement ses installations à destination des candidats présentant un handicap physique et/ou mental. Si vous avez besoin d'installations spécifiques ou d'une aide particulière pour accéder à notre site Web ou finaliser votre candidature, envoyez un e\-mail précisant votre demande à l'équipe Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com. Les demandes d’aménagement raisonnable seront examinées au cas par cas.
   

  

 Employés SAP : les candidats ne peuvent être recommandés que pour des postes permanents \- vous trouverez d'autres réglementations dans la politique de recommandation SAP.
   

  

 SAP estime que la transparence salariale contribue à instaurer une culture d’honnêteté et un environnement positif. Il s’agit d’une étape importante qui témoigne de l’engagement de SAP en faveur de l’équité salariale. **Utilisation de l’IA dans le processus de recrutement**

description:

As the world’s leading agentic AI company, H2O.ai converges Generative and Predictive AI to help enterprises and public sector agencies develop purpose\-built GenAI applications on their private data. With a focus on Sovereign AI—secure, compliant, and infrastructure\-flexible deployments—H2O.ai delivers solutions that align with the highest standards of data privacy and control.
   

  

 Our open\-source technology is trusted by over 20,000 organizations worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 500\. H2O.ai powers AI transformation for companies like AT\&T, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Chipotle, Workday, Progressive Insurance, and NIH.
   

  

 H2O.ai partners include NVIDIA, Dell Technologies, Deloitte, Ernst \& Young (EY), Snowflake, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), VAST Data and MinIO. H2O.ai’s AI for Good program supports nonprofit groups, foundations, and communities in advancing education, healthcare, and environmental conservation.  We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer who builds things that matter. This is a hands\-on engineering role embedded within a customer\-facing field team, meaning your work will be seen, used, and evaluated by real enterprises from day one.
   

  

 You will work alongside Kaggle Grandmasters, ML engineers, and domain experts to deliver AI that goes beyond demos \- into production, into workflows, and into measurable business outcomes.

* Experience building and deploying production AI systems, including APIs, backend services, or ML\-powered applications.
* Solid understanding of GenAI systems including LLMs, SLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, evaluation, and agentic workflows.

* Experience with cloud platforms and MLOps/LLMOps concepts (deployment, monitoring, governance).

 How to Stand Out From the Crowd

* Experience designing or reviewing full\-stack AI applications or platforms.

 Why H2O.ai?
   

  

* Market leader in total rewards
* Remote\-friendly culture
* Flexible working environment
* Be part of a world\-class team

 H2O.ai is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status or any other legally protected basis.
   

  

 H2O.ai is an innovative AI cloud platform company, leading the mission to democratize AI for everyone. title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Bilue is a digital consultancy that designs and builds smart, user\-friendly technology for some of Australia’s most well\-known businesses. From mobile apps to beautifully designed web platforms and digital experiences, we create solutions that drive impact and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
 



  





 Our culture is people\-first and purpose\-driven. We’re a down\-to\-earth, values\-led team with offices in Sydney and Melbourne, and a growing presence in Manila. We genuinely enjoy working together, whether we’re solving tough tech problems, brainstorming creative solutions, or grabbing a coffee between meetings. Curiosity is encouraged. Collaboration is second nature.
 



  





 We value excellence, not ego, and back each other to do great work without micromanagement. With low politics and high trust, it’s a place where delivery people, designers, and engineers genuinely connect, and where everyone has a voice, space to grow, and a little fun along the way.
 



  





**About The Role** 




  





 We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join The Foundry and work at the intersection of client delivery and internal capability building. This is a hands\-on engineering role where you’ll design, build, and ship production\-grade AI systems for Bilue’s clients across financial services, government, insurance, and retail, while simultaneously contributing to the reference architectures, tooling, and engineering standards that define how AI Labs operates.
 



  





 This isn’t a research role. It’s not a prompt\-engineering role. You’ll be building agentic systems that survive contact with real users, integrating AI into enterprise environments, and setting the quality bar for what “production\-grade” means at Bilue.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





***Client Delivery (The Foundry)***



* Design and build production\-grade AI solutions including agentic systems, memory systems, LLM\-powered features, and intelligent automation for enterprise clients.
* Architect cloud\-native AI systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP with robust DevOps/LLMOps pipelines for scalability and reliability.
* Integrate AI capabilities into existing enterprise platforms (CRM, ERP, lending systems, claims platforms) through well\-designed APIs and data pipelines (leveraging AI of course).
* Lead AI technical delivery within cross\-functional squads alongside designers, strategists, and client stakeholders — translating complex AI concepts into high\-impact outcomes.
* Implement responsible AI practices including red\-teaming, bias testing, evaluation harnesses, and human\-in\-the\-loop design before anything ships.



  





***Internal Capability (The AI Foundry)***



* Contribute to Bilue’s reference architectures for common delivery patterns: knowledge/context pipelines, agentic systems, LLM integrations, and evaluation frameworks.
* Help define and evolve engineering standards for AI Labs work — code quality, testing approaches, prompt evaluation frameworks, and what “production\-grade” means in practice.
* Build reusable tooling, accelerators, and “skills” that make the next project faster and more reliable.
* Participate in model evaluation, cost optimisation, and architecture reviews that sharpen Bilue’s technical edge.
* Share knowledge across the engineering team through documentation, tech talks, and hands\-on mentoring.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





***Experience \& Mindset***



* Demonstrable experience delivering AI or GenAI solutions in a production environment — not just prototypes or demos.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and the analytical mindset to work with ambiguous, evolving requirements.
* The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders and client executives.
* Genuine systems thought leadership — you understand why the system matters, not just how it works.
* A collaborative, low\-ego approach, working across teams, clients, and contexts with adaptability.
* Comfort operating in a fast moving environment where you’ll work across multiple clients and industries.
* Strong opinions, weakly held \- curious mind with the ability to rapidly evolve when faced with contradictory evidence.



  





***Technical Skills***



* Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with TypeScript or Java is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with AI and agentic frameworks — LangChain, AgentCore , LlamaIndex, LangGraph, CrewAI, vector databases, or similar.
* Working expertise with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Solid understanding of data engineering fundamentals — SQL, ETL/ELT, distributed systems, handling large and unstructured datasets.
* Experience designing and deploying production AI systems with proper observability, monitoring, and evaluation.
* Familiarity with LLMOps practices — prompt versioning, model drift detection, cost monitoring, A/B evaluation.
* Understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration patterns.



  





***Bonus Points***



* Experience with the AWS AI/ML stack (Bedrock, AgentCore, Strands, SageMaker, Lambda, Step Functions).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks, bias testing tools, or AI governance practices.
* Prior consulting or hyper\-scaler experience where you’ve delivered for external clients under real constraints.
* Contributions to open\-source AI projects, AI research, or published technical writing.



  





**Life at Bilue** 




  





**People\-first focus:** 
 We’re committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for our clients, but we know it starts with our people. You’ll join a values\-led team that’s collaborative, curious, and genuinely cares about doing great work, together.
 



  





**Connection that counts:** 
 From monthly anchor days and team lunches to our annual offsite, we create intentional moments to connect, collaborate, and celebrate. These aren’t just fun perks — they’re part of how we work and grow together.
 



  





**Flexibility that works:** 
 We offer hybrid working, with 1–2 days per week in the office. It’s a balance that gives you the space to do your best work, while still creating time to connect and build strong relationships in person.
 



  





**Strong internal communities:** 
 We actively foster internal communities across tech, design, delivery, and beyond, giving you plenty of chances to connect, share knowledge, and learn from your peers.
 



  





**Opportunities to grow:** 
 We invest in your development with unlimited access to Go1’s learning library and support from our internal performance coach. Whether you want to deepen your technical skills or grow your leadership potential, we’ll back you.
 



  





**Flat structure, real impact:** 
 At Bilue, everyone’s voice matters. Our leadership team is hands\-on and approachable, and we operate without unnecessary layers. We keep things open and transparent, and your ideas will be heard, no matter your title.
 



  





**Bilue \= Big \+ Blue Ocean. Are you ready to set sail? Apply now!** 




  





 NB. This is a full\-time position based in Sydney, NSW or Melbourne, VIC. To be considered, candidates must have unrestricted working rights in Australia.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Founding AI Engineer
 



  





 What if your next role was rebuilding entire industries with AI?
 



  





 This is a well funded company that acquires traditional services businesses and rebuilds them from the ground up. Insurance, property, legal, financial services. They buy established businesses in these sectors and transform how they operate with AI at the core. We're talking agentic systems that replace entire manual workflows and make decisions in real time.
 



  





 The thesis is simple and the ambition is not. These industries still run on manual processes and people doing repetitive work that software should be doing. This company acquires them, keeps what works, and rebuilds the rest. The founding engineering team is already in the building and shipping. They need another engineer who thinks the same way they do.
 



  





**Who you are** 




  





 So you probably started somewhere structured. A bank, a tech company, maybe a decent sized startup where you learned how things are supposed to work. And then you left for something harder. You joined early. Employee 3 or 7 or 10\. You built the core platform from scratch and you stuck around long enough to see real money move through systems you designed. Somewhere along the way you went deep on AI. Shipping products where the model is in the critical path. Agentic workflows, automated decisioning, systems that replace entire manual processes end to end. You might have had a stint as CTO or tech lead but you chose to go back to building because that's what you actually love doing. You care about what makes a business more valuable, not just what's technically interesting. You're in Sydney and you want the founding engineer seat because you genuinely prefer building the plane while flying it.
 



  





**The work** 




  





 You'll be walking into real businesses with real operations and figuring out what to build. You sit with operators, watch how they work, understand where the value is, and then build the AI systems that transform how the business runs. One week you might be standing up an agentic workflow that automates a manual process. The next you might be building document ingestion pipelines for a professional services firm. The problems change because the businesses change, but the core challenge stays the same: take something that runs on people and paper, and rebuild it so it runs on AI.
 



  





 You'll be working alongside engineers who've already done this at serious scale. The bar is high, and the expectations are clear. Ship real systems that create value. The stack is whatever gets the job done. You'll have full ownership of what gets built and how. If you've spent your career gravitating toward the messiest, least defined problems because that's where the interesting work is, this is that.

 We are looking for an AI Engineer who thinks creatively about AI\-assisted development, is still on a steep growth trajectory, and wants to learn AI architecture as their native mental model rather than retrofitting it onto pre\-AI\-era engineering habits. Based in Melbourne, you will orchestrate AI\-assisted workflows against bounded specifications under an opinionated scaffold that catches the bugs experience usually catches. This is a small team with executive sponsorship building both Catapult's customer\-facing intelligence platform and the internal tooling that makes Catapult engineering durable. If you operate well within strong structure and have genuine curiosity about how AI architecture is reshaping the engineering discipline, we should talk.
   

  

 The AI engineering role at Catapult is structurally different from a conventional engineering role: you will not write code line\-by\-line all day. Your job is to direct AI\-assisted workflows against bounded problems, review the output, surface architectural decisions that need escalation upward, and capture learnings back into the team's shared knowledge as work surfaces them.
   

  

**The Work Spans**
* The customer\-facing intelligence platform (knowledge graph, context synthesis pipeline, evaluation infrastructure)
* The internal AI tooling (our internal MCPs)
* Integration plumbing (auth, ingestion, data flows from all Catapult sources, Cognito\-fronted endpoints)
* Multi\-agent reasoning systems (different AI perspectives debating over the same knowledge base)


**What You’ll Do**
* Query the team's knowledge MCP (Model Context Protocol, the Anthropic standard for AI tools to access external services) for relevant practices and decisions before acting; capture decisions back as work surfaces them.
* Produce verified output. Hardware test or end\-to\-end validation as part of "done." No "looks correct" judgments. We care about the quality of our product deeply.
* Help productise multi\-agent reasoning: different agent perspectives orchestrated over a shared knowledge base.


**What You’ll Need**
**Required** 
 (you won't tick every box \-\- we're looking for the person, not the checklist)
 **:**
* High trajectory You've grown fast in the last 2 years, demonstrably, with concrete examples.
* Creative judgment You can evaluate code or design choices and articulate what's good and bad about them. Show us a piece of code in an interview; we'll ask you to evaluate it, not fix it.
* Genuine curiosity about AI architecture Not "uses AI tools." Architectures AI tools into your workflow. You have opinions about how AI architecture is reshaping the engineering discipline, and those opinions are grounded in attempted use rather than reading.
* Strong fundamentals in at least one systems language (Go, Rust, C\+\+) and one scripting language (Python, TypeScript) We care about engineering judgment more than language fluency; the scaffold helps you ramp on a new language quickly.
* 2\-5 years professional production engineering experience You have enough experience to have developed your own judgment, but not so much that pre\-AI\-era patterns are deeply ingrained.


**Highly valued** 
 (same rule \-\- we're looking for the person, not the checklist):
   

  

* Direct experience with AI\-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Aider) deeply enough to have developed your own opinions about their failure modes.
* Experience with Neo4j or other graph databases.
* Experience with Cognito, OAuth federation, or JWT\-based identity flows.
* Experience with Go MCP servers, Python data ingestion, or AWS infrastructure.
* Familiarity with sports data, sensor systems, or wearable technology. Not required, but helpful.
* Open\-source contribution history that shows trajectory \+ creative judgment.


**Anti\-profile (worth Being Explicit About)**
* Engineer whose primary mode is following established methodology rather than thinking creatively about it. Many engineering roles reward rule\-following; this one rewards creative judgment within structure.
* "Used Cursor once" candidates whose AI\-tooling familiarity is shallow. We're looking for genuine architectural curiosity, not exposure.


**WHY CATAPULT?**
* We have amazing people. We promise you’ll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
* We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.
* We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
* Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.
* We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high\-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.


 Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!
   

  

 Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalised groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.
   

  

 All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

The Warehouse Group (TWG) has become a Kiwi household name, and we proudly recognise the role that we play in communities throughout New Zealand. We are the largest general merchandise retailer in NZ across The Warehouse, Warehouse Stationery \& Noel Leeming. We are at an exciting point in our journey where our focus is on becoming brand\-centric, aiming to deliver an unparalleled experience for our customers. Agility and collaboration are cornerstones of our work culture, empowering us to adapt swiftly and work seamlessly together. By being brand\-led and retail\-focused, we are intentional about placing the right people in the right roles, allowing us to perform work that truly makes a difference.


Our Technology footprint is extensive and underpins the successful running of our group operation. From our digital presence to our warehouse and order management systems and everything in between, we’re a place technologists want to be, and we’d love you to be part of it.

**Job Description**
-------------------


This isn’t your average AI Engineering role. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer \- Lead to help shape how AI solutions are designed, built, and delivered across The Warehouse Group.


As we continue to grow our Data \& AI capability, you’ll play a key role leading the technical delivery of AI initiatives – providing hands\-on architectural guidance, mentoring emerging engineers, and ensuring solutions move successfully from prototype through to production. If you’re excited by solving complex technical challenges, building scalable AI solutions, and helping grow capability in others, this could be your next opportunity.


Sitting within our Data \& AI function and reporting into the Group Chief Data \& AI Officer, you’ll work closely with AI Engineers, Data Engineers, Architecture, Security, and wider business stakeholders to deliver pragmatic, secure, and scalable AI solutions across the organisation.


This is a highly technical leadership role where your expertise will be essential from day one. You’ll contribute directly to solution design and engineering while also setting standards, guiding best practice, and acting as a trusted technical lead for the graduate AI capability.


Day to day, you could be involved in:

* Providing technical leadership and architectural guidance across AI initiatives delivered by the graduate capability team
* Leading the design of AI solutions including LLM\-based applications, RAG architectures, and agent workflows
* Reviewing and approving code, pipelines, and solution designs to ensure quality, security, scalability, and maintainability
* Supporting the transition of AI solutions from prototype to production\-ready environments
* Mentoring and coaching Graduate AI Engineers and Data Engineers to build capability and engineering discipline
* Collaborating with Enterprise IT, Architecture, and Security teams to support production deployments
* Contributing hands\-on to complex or foundational builds where required
* Defining and uplifting AI engineering standards, patterns, and best practices across the function
* Acting as a technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges
* Staying current with emerging AI technologies and recommending practical adoption opportunities
**Qualifications**
------------------


First and foremost, you’re passionate about building high\-quality AI solutions that are scalable, secure, and fit for purpose. You’re equally comfortable being hands\-on technically while also mentoring others and providing technical leadership across delivery initiatives.


You will bring the following to the role:

* Significant experience in software engineering and applied AI development
* Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI application frameworks
* Proven experience deploying AI or data\-driven solutions into production environments
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP
* Experience designing APIs, data pipelines, and integration patterns
* Strong engineering discipline across code review, testing, documentation, and maintainability
* Experience mentoring or guiding early\-career engineers
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
* A collaborative mindset with the ability to work across technical and non\-technical teams
* Curiosity, pragmatism, and a continuous improvement mindset


It would also be advantageous if you have experience with:

* LLM platforms and architectures including RAG, agent workflows, and evaluation frameworks
* MLOps or AI operational practices
* Enterprise security, identity, and data governance requirements
* Fast\-moving, iterative delivery environments
**Additional Information**
--------------------------


We are intentional about finding the right people, allowing us to perform work as a team that truly makes a difference for the business and our customers. In return, you’ll get exposure to exciting technology, meaningful projects, and the opportunity to learn from passionate and experienced people in the Data \& AI space.

  

  

**Apply now** and make an impact with one of Aotearoa’s most trusted retailers.

**Be part of our journey to make sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone.**

 You’ll tackle a wide range of technical challenges across diverse projects and environments, continuously developing your capabilities in generative and agentic AI, cloud engineering, and applied AI systems \- ensuring ongoing learning and growth.
   

  

**About The Role And Team**
 This is an exciting hands\-on role that enables full stack, end\-to\-end delivery of AI projects using leading digital platforms and foundation models. You will work across a diverse range of responsibilities, including architecting and deploying generative and multiagent workflows with tool use and function calling, tightly integrated with enterprise data platforms and systems.
   

  

 The role provides opportunities to work in challenging technical environments across multiple industries and business functions. You will also help develop the tools and accelerators our consulting teams use to embed generative AI in their everyday work. * Standing up robust LLMOps capabilities, including automated evaluations, observability and tracing, offline and online testing, prompt versioning, safety redteaming, and cost/latency optimisation.

* Implementing retrieval and grounding strategies (chunking, hybrid search, metadata filtering) and feedback loops to improve reliability, quality, and factuality of generative AI systems.
* Partnering with engagement leads to scope, estimate, and deliver work packages, and contributing to accelerators, reference architectures, and reusable GenAI components.

description:
**About Allexive** 




  





 Most companies have done an AI workshop or training series. They've got a pilot in flight that nobody's quite sure how to scale. They are AI\-aware, and stuck.
 



  





 Allexive is the AI transformation arm of the Overdose Group. We turn AI\-aware organisations into AI\-operational ones, working with mid\-market and enterprise clients across NZ and Australia by shipping working systems.
 



  





**The work spans three altitudes:** 




  




* **Build** 
 . Production\-grade AI systems shipped into the client's environment. PoC or multi\-phase Build Sprint.
* **AI Platform Implementation** 
 . We stand up a client team's AI operating model from the foundation up: the data layer their agents reason over, the platform in their tenancy, the context architecture their Skills and agents draw from, the starter library of those Skills and agents, and the change management that turns it into how the team works. Converts to monthly retainer.
* **Enterprise AI infrastructure** 
 . We architect the shared AI plane the rest of a client's strategy runs on: MCP gateway, shared controls, agentic commerce protocols, vendor selection, phased build roadmap to capital committee.



  





**The opportunity:** 




  





 The pipeline is outpacing capacity, and the technical surface area is widening across all three altitudes above. We're looking for someone to support the technical direction of the business as we scale into new markets and new services.
 



  





 Day to day, that means a top\-line seat on engagements: owning the technical relationship with clients through delivery, shaping new opportunities from a technical lens, and leading the work alongside our engineering capacity and delivery partners.
 



  





**What you'll actually do:** 




  





**Delivery (60%).** 
 Lead technical execution across all three altitudes: Build, AI Platform and Capability, and Enterprise AI infrastructure. Translate scoped problems into working software, direct the engineering capacity around you, and stay hands\-on with the spiky bits.
 



  





**Client relationship (20%).** 
 Own the technical relationship through delivery. Run working sessions, alignment gates, and demos. Be the person the client trusts to tell them the truth about what's working, what isn't, and what to do next.
 



  





**Pre\-sales (20%).** 
 Join discovery and scoping calls as Allexive's technical voice. Pressure\-test feasibility, shape proposals and SOWs with the senior team, and spot engagement\-shaped problems inside messy client conversations.
 



  





**The shape of person we're looking for:** 




  





 You're probably
 **6\-10 years into engineering, with 2\-4 years of that hands\-on with modern AI** 
 , but the years matter less than the shape:
 



  




* **A little obsessed with AI.** 
 You live at the bleeding edge: Twitter, YouTube, Reddit, Discords, arXiv. You read the Anthropic and OpenAI release notes the day they ship. Andrej Karpathy is a parasocial friend.
* **Curious enough to tinker with what's not yet enterprise\-ready.** 
 OpenClaw, Hermes, local models, open\-weight agent frameworks. You understand the security ramifications of each, and where the line sits between "fun on my laptop" and "appropriate to put in front of a client".
* **Deep on the technical concepts.** 
 Context windows, attention patterns, eval design, hybrid retrieval, MCP server architecture, agentic control flow. Explained in a way a CTO trusts and a junior engineer can learn from.
* **Professional services background with mid\-market and enterprise clients.** 
 You've delivered across multiple industries, context\-switched between them, and know what "billable" means.
* **Builder first.** 
 Shipped production AI systems, not just demos. In code today, not "used to code".
* **Client\-grade communicator.** 
 Can run a room of 8 stakeholders, write a clear status email, and disagree with a CTO without making it weird.
* **Commercially literate.** 
 Knows a sprint is a commercial commitment, and when to flag a scope drift before it becomes a write\-off.
* **NZ\-based.** 
 Auckland preferred. Remote\-friendly within NZ. Occasional travel to client sites.



  





 This is not an easy role. In exchange, you get a front\-row seat to where the AI industry is going: leading customers, frontier\-lab partnerships, and cutting\-edge work alongside some of NZ's sharpest thinkers in this space.
 



  





**Must\-have technical skills:** 




  





**Modern applied AI** 



* Production experience with at least one agent framework:
 **Google ADK** 
 ,
 **Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF)** 
 , or
 **Claude Agent SDK** 
 (two of three a strong signal)
* LLM fluency: tool use, prompt caching, structured outputs, streaming, function/tool schemas, retries and fallbacks
* Context engineering and MCP architecture (servers, clients, tools, resources, prompts). Has built or extended an MCP server
* RAG patterns: chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, rerankers, vector databases
* Grounded generation, citation patterns, hallucination mitigation



  





**LLMOps discipline** 



* Automated evaluations for non\-deterministic systems, offline and online
* Observability, tracing, prompt versioning, regression testing
* Safety and redteam patterns: prompt\-injection defences, PII handling, content moderation, auditability
* Cost and latency optimisation in production
* You stand up the operational layer that keeps a production AI system honest, not just the demo that wins the room



  





**Enterprise AI infrastructure thinking** 



* Reasoned about shared AI infrastructure at enterprise scale: MCP gateway patterns, capability taxonomies, A2A and agentic commerce protocols (UCP / ACP)
* Familiar with the shared controls layer: identity and delegation, mandate registries, policy engines, state management
* Designs agents with security, auditability, and controlled blast radius at the forefront. Can articulate the difference between a demo\-grade agent and one safe to deploy in production
* Comfortable defending a position on vendor selection, gateway placement, or governance boundaries in a room of enterprise architects



  





**Engineering** 



* Strong TypeScript/Node
 **or** 
 Python (both a bonus)
* Cloud\-fluent across AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel.
 **AWS experience highly valued** 
 (primary cloud for NZ/AU market)
* Comfortable wiring AI systems to messy enterprise data, undocumented APIs, and client stacks (CRMs, ERPs, file stores, comms tools)



  





**Nice\-to\-have** 



* Public technical writing, conference talks, or open\-source contributions



  





**What you'll get:** 




  




* A senior seat at a fast\-moving firm with real clients and real outcomes
* Direct line into the founder and senior team, with no middle layer between you and the work or the strategy
* A front\-row view of NZ and AU enterprise AI transformation, across multiple industries
* Salary and equity / profit\-share to be agreed based on seniority. Competitive with senior eng \+ consulting roles in NZ
* Remote\-friendly within NZ, with client travel as required
* Real budget for tools, models, and learning. We use what we recommend



  





**How we work:** 




  




* **We're AI\-native, not just AI\-selling.** 
 Claude Code, agentic workflows, and parallel\-agent orchestration are how we ship. You'll use them, extend them, and push the practice forward.
* **You're not flying solo.** 
 The senior team is on every engagement alongside you, with engineering capacity under you. Accountability is shared.
* **We ship in weeks, not quarters.** 
 If something is going to take three months without intermediate value, we've scoped it wrong. You'll help us scope better.
* **We don't do consulting theatre.** 
 No 40\-page strategy documents nobody reads. No "AI maturity assessments" that end in a slide deck. The deliverable is the working thing.
* **We tell clients the truth.** 
 Including when the answer is "you don't need AI for this".

**Summary**
 The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that support intelligent automation, predictive insight, and advanced analytics across the enterprise. As a hands\-on builder, this role applies software engineering principles to write production\-quality code, build scalable AI systems, including AI Agents and data pipelines, and integrate AI models into new and existing business applications. The AI Engineer collaborates closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, ML Ops Engineers, and Platform teams to bring machine learning models from prototype to production. A critical part of this function is to ensure that AI use cases are transitioned from experimentation into reliable, governed, and business\-ready solutions by owning their complete operational readiness. This includes implementing robust observability, defining Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and establishing clear incident response and rollback strategies for all AI services.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
 Model Development \& Implementation
   

  

* Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code to develop and implement machine learning and AI models that support various business use cases.
* Implement data engineering and preprocessing workflows required for model inputs.
* Continuously optimize the performance and scalability of AI applications and models.


 ML Pipelines \& Operations (MLOps)
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable ML pipelines for model training, validation, inference, and deployment.
* Collaborate with ML Ops Engineers to package and deploy models into enterprise systems using established MLOps practices.
* Monitor deployed models in production for performance, data drift, and reliability, and troubleshoot and resolve any issues that arise.
* Establish and own the operational readiness of all AI services by defining and implementing Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for key metrics, such as p50/p95 latency and availability, and creating robust monitoring and alerting for model drift, latency, and error rates.


 Collaboration \& Integration
   

  

* Work closely with Data Scientists to transition experimental models and research prototypes into robust, production\-ready systems.
* Support the integration of AI capabilities into enterprise workflows, applications, and digital platforms.
* Contribute to the documentation and explainability of model outputs to ensure clarity for business stakeholders.


 Governance \& Strategy
   

  

* Ensure all deployed AI systems comply with enterprise governance, fairness, and security standards.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, such as LLMs and generative AI, to assess their applicability to business problems and drive innovation.


**Preferred Skills/Knowledge/Experience**
 Core Technical \& AI Proficiency
   

  

* Strong coding skills in Python, Java, or C\+\+, including API development and software design
* Deep understanding of core machine learning concepts, including classification, regression, clustering, and deep learning architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks and algorithms (supervised/unsupervised), such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar for building and training complex neural networks.
* Skills in working with LLMs, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and using frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph to build RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems.
* Handling data wrangling, SQL, data warehousing, and ETL pipelines to prepare data for models


 End\-to\-End ML Model Lifecycle
   

  

* Proven experience in the end\-to\-end model lifecycle: developing, training, and deploying machine learning models from prototype to production.
* Mastery of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques to ensure robust and accurate model performance.
* Demonstrated ability to build and optimize scalable data pipelines for training and evaluating machine learning models.
* Strong knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases for querying and managing data for AI applications.


 Software \& MLOps Engineering
   

  

* Solid foundation in software engineering best practices, including version control (Git), automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands\-on experience with containerization using Docker and container orchestration with Kubernetes for scalable deployment.
* Expertise in MLOps observability, including model monitoring to track performance and drift, and establishing model/version lineage, telemetry, and traceability.
* Experience implementing advanced testing and deployment strategies, including canary/shadow deployments and comprehensive test suites (unit, integration, adversarial, regression).
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI models and services into enterprise applications by building and consuming RESTful APIs.


 Cloud \& Infrastructure
   

  

* Proficiency with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, Azure) and its associated AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, SageMaker, Azure ML).
* Experience with big data technologies, such as Apache Spark or similar, for processing large\-scale datasets in a cloud environment.


 Collaboration \& Frontend Development
